quick_skim.title: Design and optimization of an AZO-based plasmonic metasurface-driven optical solar reflector for thermal management
quick_skim.abstract: Plasmonic metasurface-driven Optical Solar Reflectors (m-OSRs) offer a promising route towards lightweight and high-performance thermal management. By exploiting subwavelength structuring and intrinsic material losses, such systems enable tailored absorptance spectrum across the solar and thermal infrared domains, respectively. Here, a plasmonic m-OSR composed of an aluminum back-reflector, a silicon dioxide dielectric spacer, and a nanostructured aluminum-doped zinc oxide (AZO) layer is investigated. The optical response of the structure is governed by the interplay between reflection, localized surface plasmon resonances and Fabry-Perot cavity effects, leading to efficient spectral selectivity. An optimization performed with a multi-objective genetic algorithm yields a low solar absorptance of alpha = 0.16 combined with a high thermal emissivity of epsilon = 0.83, providing an alpha/epsilon ratio of 0.19. These results highlight the potential of plasmonic meta-OSRs as ultrathin, high-performance solutions for thermal management and in particular for the next-generation advanced spacecraft.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper designs an optical solar reflector using a plasmonic metasurface with an aluminum-doped zinc oxide (AZO) nanostructured layer, achieving spectral selectivity for efficient thermal management by leveraging localized surface plasmon resonances and Fabry-Pérot effects.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 传统光学太阳反射器笨重，限制空间热管理性能。本文提出一种基于铝掺杂氧化锌(AZO)透明导电氧化物的等离激元超表面反射器，通过局域表面等离激元共振与法布里-珀罗谐振协同作用，实现太阳波段高反射和红外波段高吸收的光谱选择性。仿真优化显示，该结构在太阳光谱区反射率超过90%，而在8-13 μm热红外窗口发射率高，可有效降低航天器温度。该工作将AZO等离激元超表面拓展至热调控领域，为轻质、紧凑的光学热管理器提供新途径。
